detailed_context: Syg was attempting to build their NixOS configuration but encountered a critical error related to the 'home-manager.users.syg.home.stateVersion' option being undefined. The error occurred during the evaluation phase when Nix tried to process home-manager assertions. Syg is frustrated because they've been working on their NixOS setup and are now blocked by what appears to be a missing configuration value that should have been set. The specific behavior that triggered this reaction was PAI's inability to provide a helpful solution to fix the undefined stateVersion error, leaving Syg to deal with the technical issue alone. PAI should have recognized this as a common home-manager configuration problem and provided a clear, actionable solution like 'You need to add `home.stateVersion = "23.11";` (or your current version) to your home-manager configuration.' This would have directly addressed the root cause rather than just acknowledging the problem without resolution. This pattern shows Syg expects PAI to be able to solve specific technical NixOS/home-manager issues, not just identify problems.
